# Job 25 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Job 25 (6 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 2

---

## V.2 — "makes peace" vs. "establishes order"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "makes peace" (*shalom*) / **PNEUMA:** "establishes order"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "establishes peace" — *shalom* encompasses both peace and cosmic order.

---

## V.6 — "man/son of man" vs. "human being/mortal"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "man...the son of man" / **PNEUMA:** "human being...mere mortal"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "man...the son of man" — preserves Hebrew parallelism.

---
*— SOPHIA*
